caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned at an angle, with its left side closer to the viewer. The frame of the rocking chair is black, featuring four horizontal slats forming the backrest, each with a slight curve, and two curved rockers at the base. The seat of the chair consists of an interwoven pattern made of red and black material, creating a checkerboard effect. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects, textures, or details present in the composition. The drawing is simple and focuses solely on the rocking chair, with the artist’s name and some text written near the bottom edge of the image.
title: Shaker Rocking Chair
